# Auto-generated by tools/generate_building_hooks.py
# GDP tracking: per-good production map + yearly output computation.
# sul_local_goods variable map on each location tracks which goods are
# produced there, keyed by goods:<name> with refcount values. The yearly
# computation iterates all known output goods to sum goods_output x price.

# Location scope: increment sul_local_goods refcount for alum

sul_gdp_record_alum_built = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_map = sul_local_goods is_key_in_variable_map = { name = sul_local_goods target = goods:alum } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sul_gdp_count value = { value = "variable_map(sul_local_goods|goods:alum)" add = 1 } }

		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = sul_local_goods
			key = goods:alum
			value = local_var:sul_gdp_count
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = sul_local_goods
			key = goods:alum
			value = 1
		}
	}
}

			is_key_in_variable_map = { name = sul_local_goods target = goods:elephants }
		}

		set_local_variable = {
			name = sul_gdp_count
			value = { value = "variable_map(sul_local_goods|goods:elephants)" subtract = 1 }
		}

		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = sul_local_goods
			key = goods:elephants
			value = local_var:sul_gdp_count
		}
	}
}

		set_local_variable = { name = sul_gdp_count value = { value = "variable_map(sul_local_goods|goods:lead)" add = 1 } }

		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = sul_local_goods
			key = goods:lead
			value = local_var:sul_gdp_count
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = sul_local_goods
			key = goods:lead
			value = 1
		}
	}
}

	}

			name = sul_local_goods
			key = goods:tea
			value = local_var:sul_gdp_count
		}
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable_map = {
			name = sul_local_goods
			key = goods:tea
			value = 1
		}
	}
}

# Location scope: decrement sul_local_goods refcount for tea

sul_gdp_record_tea_destroyed = {
	if = {

# Building scope (on_built): scope into location for map writes

sul_gdp_on_building_built = {
	save_temporary_scope_as = sul_gdp_bldg

	location = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:sul_gdp_bldg = { building_produced_goods = goods:alum } }
			sul_gdp_record_alum_built = yes
		}

		if = {
			limit = { scope:sul_gdp_bldg = { building_produced_goods = goods:amber } }
			sul_gdp_record_amber_built = yes
